reviews.title: Error in para 27
reviews.text: Over all your app is great and easy to learn and recite Quran but There is a little mistake in 27 para first Surah last line. There is error of zer(زیر). Please fix this issue. And please check whole Quran app once again.

reviews.title: Freeze issue
reviews.text: The app is good but when I first use it it perfectly works normally but if I want to use the app again it doesn’t work it just freezes so everything time I want to read the Quran on the app I have to redownload the app just for it to work plz fix this
